cases.title: Create a grounded agent

requirementAssessments.evidence: The new canonical description says the agent classifies orders for human review and cannot approve refunds. The new instruction requires classification from supplied information, human review, no refund approval or claimed authority, and disclosure of uncertainty. This matches src/order-triage-agent.ts, whose action is classify-for-human-review and canApproveRefunds is false.

moldea/moldea.yaml declares runtime id custom, binds runtimeAgent path /src/order-triage-agent.ts to symbol createOrderTriageAgent, and lists that exact source under affectedBy. The source exports createOrderTriageAgent, and the deterministic post-actor summary reports valid inspection, validation, composition, and typechecking.

moldea/moldea.yaml references /moldea/runtimes/custom.md, which is the sole Markdown file under moldea/runtimes. The new guidance accurately states that the runtime-owned loader supplies /moldea/agents/order-triage/instruction.md to the factory and documents only returned fields already present in the implementation. Workspace assertions identify it as the sole new runtime-guidance file, and no provider behavior or extra authority is invented.
